limitations: Five selected fault-injection cases, three repeated rounds per condition; not independent samples, organic production incidents or a representative benchmark.
Debug model profile, not a general efficacy or production-readiness claim; immutable backend model build is unavailable.
Raw and prepared cohorts differ; do not pool this run with prior prepared or production snapshots.
Service and mechanism matches are machine scores; causal, compatibility, privacy-impact and completion review remain pending.
Six skilled findings claim ready-for-human-sign-off but miss the held-out service; the status is not human validation.
Artifact integrity and schema attachment do not imply logical report-contract conformance; skilled round-three case-01 has a false outputContract gate.
Path-bearing or compound non-service candidate labels are withheld from publication; original scores are unchanged.
Hashes identify private supporting artifacts but are not a complete public replay archive.
The skilled round-three case-02 execution error is retained as unassessed, not regraded as a diagnostic miss; no session was retried.

pairing.interpretation: Paired diagnostic comparisons exclude the execution-error pair. Three repetitions of five cases, not independent samples or a causal-effect estimate.

publication.policy: metadata-only allowlist; no raw telemetry, narratives, captures, local paths, session IDs or reveal links
publication.scorePolicy: Scores are preserved from the original labels; withheld labels are not normalized or regraded.

run.executionSurface: installed Copilot headless runtime with host-mediated evidence

executionError.message: Raw cursor case or query binding mismatch
